newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Tribune Co cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Tribune Co cut.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said it downgraded Tribune Co to buy from strong buy.

-- Said Tribune management gave an upbeat presentation on Wednesday, saying there were committed to increase shareholder value through internal growth, acquisitions, share repurchases and dividend increases.
-- Downgraded the stock since the new price target of $56 a share "falls outside of our strong buy parameters."
-- Expects revenue to increase 11 to 12 percent with a 27 percent improvement in operating cash flow for the year.
-- Said Tribune management hopes to make additional acquisitions within the next year.
-- Said second quarter earnings "should be robust."
-- Said Tribune management plans to spend about $100 million in share buybacks throughout the remainder of the year.
